notes: Aethernet is now about 40% smaller, and its daily update check downloads about 1 KB instead of the whole script.
The installed file is minified. **About** links to the readable source (the same build, unminified).
Fixed: in the first few minutes after a release, **Update** could open the previous version. New versions are now offered once they're fully out.
New: **Check for updates** at the bottom of Settings. If there's a newer version, one click opens Tampermonkey's Update page.
When a new version is out, an **update available** pill appears within about 15 minutes, with an **Update** button.
New: **Aethernet notices**. When the team knows about a problem, a banner under Portal's header says what's wrong and that it's being worked on. Affected crystals are marked in Settings.
If a crystal is misbehaving, the team can pause it everywhere until it's fixed; the banner says which ones are paused.
New: **Patch notes**. Open them from the bottom of Settings; every release gets its own panel with the date and time it went out.
The **Aethernet has updated!** pill now opens these patch notes (Settings stays open underneath).
**Macrocosmos**: the button wears the hotbar macro gear and shows its macro name, **GD Exception**, on hover.
The first time the Macrocosmos button appears, a short explainer points at it, with a link straight to its settings.
Settings can now open straight to one crystal with its settings expanded.
Every crystal now shows its FINAL FANTASY XIV action icon in Settings and About.
The Galaxy Diagnostics pill is now the **Macrocosmos** icon itself, like a hotbar slot: click to file, drag to move.
**Glamour** now switches Portal's own light/dark theme, so theme-specific images (Inventory icons, the Reports banner) match your theme.
**Glamour**: dark themes put Portal in dark mode, so the ubreakifix logo turns white. Your own Portal mode comes back when you pick the Portal theme.
Portal is now written as a proper noun everywhere.

New crystal: **Glamour** (page theming). Pick a preset (Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, Crystarium, Ul'dah, Ishgard, The Void) or make your own from a background, text and accent colour. Previews live; Cancel puts yours back.
Crystals are now named after FFXIV actions: Divination, Esuna, Recitation, Swiftcast, Macrocosmos, Bountiful Yield and Quick Synthesis.
An **Aethernet has updated!** pill appears once after each update.
New crystals get a yellow sheen in Settings until you've seen them.
Each crystal's settings now sit under it in the Crystals list.
Settings sections collapse, and remember which ones you left open.
New subtitle: Restoring the *flow* of NextGen.
New **About** window: version, build time, author, your setup, and the install link to share with another store.
The Aethernet name in titles uses its own wordmark.
New crystal: **Buyback add-all** (now Bountiful Yield). Adds every Apple (TLC) or Samsung/Google (UROC) part in a buyback order's Add buyback parts popout.
Fixed: its buttons no longer need the script removed and re-added before each buyback.
Aethernet's tools are now called **crystals**. Your on/off switches carry over.
**Text → WO note** now works in every browser, including Firefox and Zen: it spots sent texts from the browser's own network log.
Attempted fix for **Text → WO note** on Firefox and Zen (finished in 2.3.2).
New crystal: **Text → WO note** (now Recitation). Texting a customer from a WO adds a note: "<you> sent a text message to <customer>." followed by the message.
New crystal: **WO cleanings pill** (now Esuna). On a work order, shows whether the device has cleanings available or done, with Create for available ones.
Pending cleanings in the cleaning-rate list get a ⚡ to create them, behind a confirmation.
Aethernet now installs from a link and updates itself.
The cleaning rate counts cleanings still waiting in Arrivals, shown as dashed chips.
The cleaning list shows each customer's name instead of the device nickname.

First Aethernet release: one install bundling the cleaning auto-close ⚡, the live cleaning rate badge, the Galaxy Diagnostics exception button and Print all labels, with a Settings menu in Portal's avatar menu.
